# Tailstick

> Tailstick is a USB-delivered Tailscale enrollment tool with timed leases and cleanup.

## Start here

- [Tailstick](https://tailstick.micr.dev/): Project site.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Microck/tailstick): Source code and releases.
- [Microck](https://micr.dev/): Personal homepage.

## Guidance

Use the repository and project site as the source of truth for supported platforms, setup, and security behavior.
